note: On Wadin Bay of Lac La Ronge, 27 km N of La Ronge on Hwy 102, in aspen and spruce forest; closed since the 2025 wildfires damaged it. The shore-side sites sit 20-60 m from the water behind trees and shrubs. --Claude
summary: Keep (temporarily closed). Wadin Bay was closed in 2025 (wildfire damage) and stayed closed all of 2026 (saskatchewan.ca release 2026-02-02); no 2027 reopening announced, so the stored reopens '2027' (from note prose) is cleared. Live SKPP read: 55 nightly sites in five loops (43 electric, 14 of them 15/30/50 A; 12 non-electric), 18-32 ft. Waterfront: lakefront -> lakeview recommended (every row 'Near Water - no'; nearest sites behind conifer or shrub bands). Pin fine. Phone '' -> 306-425-4220.
flags: STATUS: temporarily_closed confirmed for 2026 ('Wadin Bay campground in Lac La Ronge Provincial Park will remain closed for the season', saskatchewan.ca 2026-02-02). reopens '2027' was derived from the note with no source; cleared (null). Recheck in spring 2027. The Tourism SK listing still says 'closed for camping in 2025' (stale).

WATERFRONT (downgrade recommended, not --AWH): lakefront -> lakeview. Nearest nightly sites by SKPP GIS on Esri z17: north lobe W40 55.27004,-105.18561 (~25 m), W50 55.27050,-105.18560 (~35 m), W52 55.27074,-105.18537 (~28 m), all behind a dense conifer band; W53 55.27112,-105.18546 (~55 m; its photo shows the bay over shrubs); south loop W5-W7 (55.26343-55.26355,-105.1858/-105.1853) ~40-60 m behind trees. East-bay Spruce loop W27 55.26700,-105.18360 (18 ft only), W28 55.26708,-105.18376, W29 55.26712,-105.18401 (nightly non-electric) are ~20-35 m from the water; current Esri imagery shows light, open-looking (likely burned) ground between, but the SKPP photos of W28/W29 show a solid screen of aspen. Every row 'Near Water - no'. Re-check W28/W29 when the campground reopens: if the ground to the bay stays open, they could hold lakefront.
